scope: Targeted static implementation/caller audit of five contract areas, not execution of the upstream application or a claim every cached source line was reviewed

upstream.retrieval: T01 cached source SHA256 rechecked; complete compressed Git tree; new public Contents API then fixed raw fallback on rate limit. Every cached file Git blob verified. Timed-out archive and partial tree were not used as source evidence.

license.noticeRequirement: Retain copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
license.note: Only source URLs, cryptographic hashes and analysis are stored in project; public upstream source cache is temporary /tmp evidence.

limitations: No upstream application/tests/model/embedding server executed; source tests are read-only evidence of intent and logic.
No universal all-driver fingerprint, complete financial-budget absence, all-online-timer SLA deadline or full-corpus semantic recall inferred from bounded inspection.
Source cached outside repository; only metadata/hashes/analysis retained in repository. Refetch at fixed commit and validate both Git blob SHA1 and SHA256 if cache is gone.
No production activation, daily database/credential/token-ledger access, remote writes or billing reconciliation.

validation.review: Three independent domain audits and read-only report reviews; no unresolved substantive finding
